title: Caleb Porter - Staff Writer
contentHtml: Besides eating, sleeping, and converting oxygen into carbon dioxide, music is very much my life. I currently play drums for Brunettes and Intercourse and have recorded multiple instruments for Vouroborus and Eave. I spend my free time digging through tags on Bandcamp trying to find as many bands and sounds as possible. Though my taste in music is at its base hardcore and metal, I find it very easy to dig or at least appreciate some artists in all forms of music.
